title: ASR fine-tuning (v0.71.32)
description: ASR fine-tuning (v0.71.32) — soup train with task: asr fine-tunes OpenAI Whisper on your own audio, locally. JSONL rows of {audio, text} with data.format: asr, Seq2SeqTrainer + WhisperProcessor, optional LoRA on q/v (training.asr_lora); whisper-tiny (39M) and base (74M) train on a 4 GB GPU. soup infer --task asr transcribes and reports per-row and corpus WER/CER (pure Python, no new dependency); word accuracy feeds soup ship as the task metric. asr_language/asr_task persist to an asr_generation.json sidecar. Proof-of-mechanism on an RTX 3050: WER 1.000 to 0.000, loss 7.2 to 0.0005 at 0.4/4 GB.

headings.title: Keys this trainer does not read (v0.76.0, v0.77.0)

blocks.html:
ASR fine-tuning (v0.71.32)

soup train with task: asr fine-tunes OpenAI Whisper speech-recognition models on your own audio, locally. Data is plain JSONL rows of {"audio": "clip.wav", "text": "the transcript"}: clips decode to 16 kHz mono log-mel input features, transcripts become the decoder labels, and the trainer wraps Hugging Face Seq2SeqTrainer + WhisperProcessor. whisper-tiny (39M) and whisper-base (74M) train on a 4 GB GPU.

Config

blocks.code:
base: openai/whisper-tiny
task: asr
data:
  train: ./data/train.jsonl
  format: asr                 # rows: {"audio": "clip.wav", "text": "hello world"}
  audio_dir: ./data/audio     # audio paths resolve here (containment-checked)
training:
  epochs: 3
  lr: 1e-4
  batch_size: 2
  asr_language: en            # optional; pins + persists the decoder prefix
  asr_task: transcribe        # transcribe | translate
  asr_lora: true              # LoRA on q/v projections; default is full fine-tune
  lora: { r: 16, alpha: 32, target_modules: [q_proj, v_proj] }
output: ./out

pip install "soup-cli[train,audio]"
soup recipes use whisper-tiny-asr   # or whisper-base-asr / whisper-large-v3-asr
soup train

blocks.html:
Config fields

FieldDefaultMeaning
asr_language(none)Decoder language prefix (e.g. en). Persists to an asr_generation.json sidecar next to the weights, so inference restores it automatically.
asr_tasktranscribetranscribe or translate. Also persisted to the sidecar.
asr_lorafalsetrue trains LoRA on the q/v projections instead of full fine-tuning.

The cross-validator requires backend: transformers (so mlx / unsloth are rejected) and footgun-rejects asr_* fields when the task is not asr; a separate trainer-side gate rejects a non-Whisper base before any weight download.

Keys this trainer does not read (v0.76.0, v0.77.0)

task: asr loads Whisper and trains it as a full fine-tune, or as LoRA on q/v with asr_lora: true. Since v0.76.0 the config loader says so for the settings it never applies, instead of accepting them:

  • training.quantization. The trainer never quantises the base. An unset value now resolves to none. An explicit 4bit, 8bit or load_in_8bit: true is refused at load since v0.77.0, naming the task (training.quantization: 8bit has no effect on task='asr': its trainer never quantises the base, so no run can honour it. Delete the line or set quantization: none. Refused as of Soup v0.77.); v0.76 loaded it with a warning and treated it as none. A Quant Menu value (gptq, awq, hqq:*, ...) or a 4-bit-only setting such as bnb_4bit_quant_storage is refused at load (#795). The VRAM pre-flight budgets asr without asr_lora as a full fine-tune.
  • training.moe_lora is refused, because Whisper has no expert layers (training.moe_lora is not applied by task='asr': that trainer loads Whisper, which has no expert layers. Remove moe_lora (or set it to false).) (#1151).
  • data.chat_template, training.freeze_layers and freeze_ratio, data.add_new_tokens and new_special_tokens, and training.loraplus_lr_ratio without asr_lora: true and lora.r > 0 are refused at load, each naming the task.
  • backend: unsloth is refused with the other backends: task='asr' requires backend='transformers'.

training.gradient_checkpointing is honoured since v0.77.0 (#797, #2140). The ASR trainer now passes it to its Hugging Face training arguments; through v0.76.1 it ignored the key and always trained with checkpointing off. The default false is unchanged, so only a config that sets true behaves differently, and any enabled tier is full checkpointing on this task.

soup doctor --config <file> runs these checks without loading a model. soup recipes verify --config <file> (which needs the training stack, the [train] extra) reports task: asr without asr_lora as having no adapter, since that trainer full-fine-tunes.

Audio paths in the rows resolve against data.audio_dir when it is set, and otherwise against the directory of the local data file the row came from. Since v0.76.0 this holds on every load path. A remote URI or a Hugging Face Hub dataset has no data-file directory, so it needs data.audio_dir; without it the load stops and names the setting. Local files in a streaming data.interleave resolve against their own folders. Rows whose file lies outside the directory are skipped with the usual "rows skipped" warning, and a value naming a network share, a device or an extended-length path is skipped without being looked up (#1599). Through v0.75.2 those paths kept the value as written, so a relative path was opened against the working directory and data.audio_dir had no effect.

Inference + WER/CER

blocks.code:
soup infer --task asr --model ./out --input eval.jsonl --output preds.jsonl \
    --audio-dir ./data/audio [--asr-language en] [--asr-task transcribe]

blocks.html:
--model loads a full Whisper model or a PEFT/LoRA adapter dir. Input rows are {"audio": path} with an optional "text" reference; when references are present, each output row carries transcription, wer and cer, plus a corpus WER summary (sum of edits over sum of reference words, not a mean of per-row rates). The metrics are pure-Python word- and char-level Levenshtein with no new dependency, and word accuracy (1 - WER) plugs into soup ship as a higher-is-better task metric, so the SHIP / DON'T-SHIP verdict works for speech models too.

WER/CER use a light normalizer (casefold, strip surrounding punctuation, collapse whitespace), deliberately not the full Whisper normalizer: good for before/after deltas, not leaderboard-comparable absolutes.

Recipes

RecipeBaseSizeStatus
whisper-tiny-asropenai/whisper-tiny39MLive, validated on a 4 GB RTX 3050
whisper-base-asropenai/whisper-base74MLive, fits a 4 GB GPU
whisper-large-v3-asropenai/whisper-large-v31.5BParse-tested; needs a 16 GB+ GPU

A smolvlm-256m-sft tiny-VLM recipe ships alongside (parse-tested, target_modules pinned to q/v). v0.72.0 fixed the setup and tokenization half of issue #302 (the vision processor now mirrors pad_token from its nested tokenizer), but a full training step still needed Idefics3-aware collation, so that recipe stayed parse-only until v0.74.0, which keeps messages and images together until collation, converts legacy <image> markers to structured multimodal content, and lets the processor produce image-token expansion and architecture-specific pixel tensors.

Honesty

Proof-of-mechanism only. The live validation is a memorization run on a single RTX 3050: WER 1.000 to 0.000 and loss 7.2 to 0.0005 at 0.4 of 4 GB VRAM. That proves the loop trains end to end; real accent or domain gains need real audio. The release also fixed the hardware-fit gate mis-sizing Whisper checkpoints as 7B models, which would have wrongly blocked ASR training on consumer GPUs.

Security

Audio decodes only through the hardened loader (a soundfile pre-probe before read, symlink rejection, O_NOFOLLOW, byte caps), never through datasets auto-decode. data.audio_dir is containment-checked (realpath + commonpath); UNC paths and traversal are rejected. A missing [audio] extra, a bad audio path, or a non-Whisper base all fail with a friendly error before a GPU hour.
